title: Why didn't my scheduled payment go through?
summary: This document explains why a scheduled payment may not go through: insufficient available funds at processing time, invalid/out-of-date recipient details, scheduled amount outside policy limits, or a schedule date conflicting with processing availability. It also covers next steps (retry up to 3 times if enabled), how to resolve (update recipient info, adjust amount to meet limits, move date to processing availability), and what to do if all 3 attempts fail (review schedule settings and create a new occurrence).
